claims.quote: The Mae Klong chameleon catfish, Acrochordonichthys septentrionalis, is an akysid from western Thailand, possibly endemic to the Mae Klong drainage.
Described from the Khwae Noi River (often referred to as the River Kwai) in Kanchanaburi province, western Thailand.
There exist questionable records from the Bernam and Pahang rivers in northwestern and central Peninsular Malaysia, respectively.
